scope: Agent read all59 authored model definitions in the actual candidate source, including prediction, fictional setting, table, reading, alternatives, next evidence and inference limits. This is internal content reading, not a qualified teacher approval or textbook-page verification.
observations: Sampling frames, random assignment and correlation/causation are distinguished.
Relative proportions are explicitly not generalized to every relative-opportunity metric.
Income, assets, work hours, recorded events, births and their denominators remain distinct.
Network tables do not invent topology, edges or information value from contact counts.
Group patterns are not used as individual diagnoses, identities or legal/medical advice.
Every invented numerical situation is labeled as hypothetical; no real respondent or learner evidence is asserted.
